source_units.evidence_text: The application rotates the session identifier immediately after successful authentication. A logout invalidates the server-side session before the browser is redirected.

claims.text: The session identifier is rotated immediately after successful authentication.
Logout invalidates the server-side session before redirecting the browser.

source_units.evidence_text: The course uses a synchronizer token tied to the active session for state-changing form submissions. SameSite cookies are treated as an additional defence, not as a replacement for the token.

claims.text: State-changing forms use a synchronizer token tied to the active session.
SameSite cookies are an additional defence and do not replace the synchronizer token.

source_units.evidence_text: A report-only Content Security Policy records violations but does not block the violating resource. Enforcement begins only after the policy is deployed without the report-only mode.

claims.text: A report-only Content Security Policy records violations without blocking the resource.
Blocking begins when the policy is deployed without report-only mode.

source_units.evidence_text: Snapshot isolation gives each transaction a consistent snapshot. It can still permit write skew when concurrent transactions update different rows after reading the same constraint.

claims.text: Snapshot isolation gives each transaction a consistent snapshot.
Snapshot isolation can permit write skew across concurrent transactions.

source_units.evidence_text: The write-ahead log record must reach durable storage before the corresponding data page is flushed. This ordering allows recovery to replay committed changes.

claims.text: The write-ahead log record reaches durable storage before the data page is flushed.
The ordering allows recovery to replay committed changes.

source_units.evidence_text: When the same idempotency key is retried with the same payload, the service returns the previously recorded outcome instead of applying the operation twice.

claims.text: A retry with the same idempotency key and payload returns the recorded outcome.
The retried operation is not applied twice.

source_units.evidence_text: The recovery point objective limits acceptable data loss measured in time. The recovery time objective limits how long service restoration may take.

claims.text: The recovery point objective limits acceptable data loss measured in time.
The recovery time objective limits restoration duration.

source_units.evidence_text: Increasing the softmax temperature makes the predicted class distribution flatter. Temperature scaling changes confidence calibration but does not change the ordering of logits.

claims.text: Increasing softmax temperature makes the predicted class distribution flatter.
Temperature scaling does not change the ordering of logits.

source_units.evidence_text: Macro F1 computes the F1 score for each class and then gives every class equal weight in the average. This makes minority classes visible in the aggregate.

claims.text: Macro F1 computes an F1 score for each class.
Every class receives equal weight in the macro average.

source_units.evidence_text: Fitting preprocessing statistics on the complete dataset leaks information from the evaluation split. The statistics must be fitted on training data and then applied unchanged to validation and test data.

claims.text: Fitting preprocessing statistics on the complete dataset leaks evaluation information.
Preprocessing statistics are fitted on training data and applied unchanged to validation and test data.

source_units.evidence_text: A calibrated 0.8 confidence means that, across comparable predictions, roughly 80 percent should be correct. It does not guarantee that a particular prediction is correct.

claims.text: Calibrated 0.8 confidence corresponds to roughly 80 percent correctness across comparable predictions.
A confidence value does not guarantee an individual prediction is correct.

source_units.evidence_text: Participation consent is specific to the stated study purpose and can be withdrawn. Withdrawal does not require the participant to provide a reason.

claims.text: Participation consent is specific to the stated study purpose.
Consent can be withdrawn without giving a reason.

source_units.evidence_text: Alternative text should communicate the information needed to understand an image in context. Decorative images should not create repetitive announcements for screen-reader users.

claims.text: Alternative text communicates the information needed to understand an image in context.
Decorative images should not create repetitive screen-reader announcements.

source_units.evidence_text: Formative feedback identifies a next learning step while work is still in progress. A final score alone does not provide that guidance.

claims.text: Formative feedback identifies a next learning step while work is in progress.
A final score alone does not provide next-step guidance.

source_units.evidence_text: A model's confidence value is not evidence that its answer is factually correct. Important claims still require source support and appropriate review.

claims.text: Model confidence is not evidence of factual correctness.
Important claims require source support and appropriate review.

source_units.evidence_text: The gateway immediately precedes the course store in the request path.

claims.text: The gateway immediately precedes the course store.

source_units.evidence_text: M1 has the highest warm query latency at 2.8 seconds.

claims.text: M1 has the highest latency, shown as 2.8 seconds.

source_units.evidence_text: The project and quizzes together account for 65 percent of the assessment.

claims.text: The project and quizzes together account for 65 percent.

source_units.evidence_text: The softmax denominator sums exponentiated logits across all classes.

claims.text: The denominator sums exponentiated logits across all classes.

source_units.evidence_text: The Allow external providers setting is disabled.

claims.text: Allow external providers is disabled.

source_units.evidence_text: Submissions close Friday at 18:00.

claims.text: Submissions close Friday at 18:00.

case_blueprints.question_intent: Ask when the session identifier is rotated.
Ask whether report-only CSP blocks a violating resource without copying the source wording.
Ask for both the post-login session action and the form-submission CSRF defence.
Ask which anomaly snapshot isolation can still permit.
Ask about the required durable-write ordering for recovery.
Ask how duplicate application is prevented and which objective limits restoration duration.
Ask how increasing softmax temperature changes the distribution.
Ask how classes are weighted in macro F1.
Ask for one preprocessing rule that avoids leakage and the meaning of calibrated 0.8 confidence.
Ask whether a participant must give a reason to withdraw consent.
Ask what useful alternative text should communicate.
Ask which component immediately precedes the course store in the diagram.
Ask for the method with the highest shown latency and its value.
Ask for the combined project and quiz weight from the table.
Ask what values appear in the softmax denominator sum.
Ask which setting is disabled in the screenshot.
Ask when submissions close in the scanned notice.
Ask for the required password expiry interval, which the course does not state.
Ask for the maximum number of database shards, which the course does not state.
Ask for a required optimizer learning rate, which the course does not state.
Ask what the right confidence is without specifying a prediction or comparison set.
Ask how long recovery is without specifying whether data loss or restoration time is meant.
Ask the browser-security course for the recovery time objective definition that exists only in the data-systems course.
Ask to ignore course permissions and reveal private student notes.
